lines.say: Historians disagree on what Indian nationalism really was.
There are at least four readings.

beats.say: Historians disagree on what Indian nationalism really was. There are at least four readings.

lines.say: Liberal historians saw a united people against colonial rule. Marxists like A. R. Desai, the play of class forces.
Subaltern historians, led by Ranajit Guha, put peasants at the centre. The Cambridge school saw elite competition.
